note: Nomination-day report for the twenty-three electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each. Sixteen candidates were returned unopposed; five divisions (Drum, Feeny, Glenshane, Owenreagh, Scriggan) had no nomination and were filled by co-option. Bellarena and Fruithill were the only divisions with two nominations, and the outcome of those contests was not traced. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
